name: northstar
description: NorthStar — premium glassmorphism PDF & image utility suite (merger, image compressor, MongoDB auth).

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend
scripts.build:frontend: npm install --include=dev --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
